articles.headline: Mbappé's stunner puts France ahead against Iraq in Philadelphia
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé extends his goal tally to three for this World Cup as France take the lead against Iraq in Group I clash.

articles.headline: World Cup VAR review: Should one of Messi's record-breaking goals have been disallowed?
articles.description: For the tournament, we are taking a look at the major incidents to examine and explain the process in terms of both VAR protocol and the laws of the game.

articles.headline: Ex-Packer Freeman: Alex goal for USMNT made Father's Day
articles.description: Former Green Bay Packers receiver Antonio Freeman said watching his son, Alex, score for the United States in a World Cup game on Friday was "10,000 times better" and kicked off "the best Father's Day weekend ever."

articles.headline: Lionel Messi makes World Cup history in win over Austria
articles.description: Lionel Messi scores a historic brace and his 18th WC goal to become the World Cup's all-time leading goal scorer in Argentina's 2-0 victory against Austria.
